description.short_caption: Erythematous papules and pustules on the abdomen.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the abdomen of a patient with multiple erythematous papules and pustules scattered across the skin. The lesions vary in size and are distributed irregularly. Some lesions appear to have central pustular components, while others are more maculopapular. The surrounding skin shows no significant erythema or excoriation.

description.short_caption: Histopathology showing scabies mite within the epidermis.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a cross-section of skin with a scabies mite visible within the epidermis. The mite is located in a burrow, surrounded by keratin and inflammatory cells. The epidermis appears hyperkeratotic, and there is evidence of acanthosis. The mite is oval-shaped, with visible internal structures, and is stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E).
